Subject: Proposed full-loop windows for Alex Jenkins (senior infra) — candidate in GMT

Hi team,

Alex (cc'd) is available next week — candidate is in London (GMT). I sketched three possible full-loop options with panel sequencing that keep contiguous blocks for interviewers and provide short buffer windows for transitions and a 30-min break in the middle. Please review and indicate conflicts ASAP.

Option A (compact, 4.5h total) — starts 09:00 GMT
- 09:00–09:40: System design (Jonas)
- 09:45–10:15: Deep dive — storage/ops (Marissa)
- 10:20–11:00: Coding exercise (take-home + walkthrough) (Kimberly)
- 11:15–12:00: Leadership / bar-raising discussion (panel)

Option B (split day) — morning + late afternoon
- 09:30–10:10: System design (Jonas)
- 10:30–11:00: Behavioral / culture (Marissa)
- 15:00–15:30: Short async coding check / follow-up (Kimberly)
- 15:45–16:30: Manager + TL sync (panel)

Option C (spread, lighter morning) — starts 10:00 GMT, keeps >45m buffers

Key asks:
- Kimberly/Marissa: which option preserves your best evaluator coverage?
- Jonas: will you be able to lead the system-design block and own the prep doc?
- Mina: can you send calendar invites with correct attendee roles (panel lead vs. interviewer) and include the attached panel brief?

Attachments: alex_jenkins_resume.pdf, panel_brief.pdf (draft)

Thanks — I can pivot days if we need cross-day coordination to accommodate East coast interviewers.

—Lauren

Thanks Lauren — good options. Quick thoughts:

- Prefer Option A if we can compress to a single morning; keeps momentum and reduces context switching for the candidate.
- Can Jonas own system design and the prep doc (I'll add 4 bullet areas I'd like covered)? If Jonas is leading, I'll take the coding walkthrough immediately after to keep the technical thread tight.
- Marissa — please confirm you can cover storage/ops for 09:45–10:15 in Option A, otherwise I suggest swapping with the leadership panel so Marissa can attend both technical and bar-raising.
- Buffer: request a 20–30m buffer between the coding walkthrough and leadership panel to allow evaluators to jot notes and do a quick alignment.

Mina: when you send invites, please mark the leadership panel as 'optional' for anyone not essential. Also include the debrief Slack channel (see linked channel) and the scoring rubric link in the invite body.

If we go single-day, I'll block 12:30–13:00 local for a quick debrief call (optional) so hiring committee can sync before offers/decisions.

—Kimberly
